verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a compliance SaaS platform, but the evidence pack never documents a bulk or full-account export, open export formats, or an offboarding path. The MCP server only gives an assistant scoped read and write access to audits and evidence requests. Its framing ('so you don't have to export data') describes an adjacent capability, not data portability, so it earns no credit here.
